description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protection order on Dried leguminous Vegetables and others
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the issuance of a Revenue Protection Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It establishes new customs duty rates for specific imported goods (dried leguminous vegetables), which constitutes a regulatory change to import/export regulations. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for customs and revenue protection, not government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
